8fdb9c75.text:
Lord Stoutmantle --

The Township of Lakeshire humbly requests the aid of your Militia.  As I write this, we find ourselves under siege from both the Blackrock Orcs and Morganth's Shadowhide Gnolls.  I would not send bidding if our situation was not severe.  We await aid from Stormwind but until such help arrives, I beg of you to lend support.  Once the Kingdom is breeched, all of Humanity is in peril.

Magistrate Solomon
8fdb9c75.title: Solomon's Plea to Westfall

10877|dc8290dc.name: Courier Hammerfall
10877|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11026|40d3ed3c.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|40d3ed3c.text: You need to start learning things that are beyond my expertise! Talk to Lilliam Sparkspindle in front of the tent there. He'll set you on the right course!

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|6928abbf.name: Newton Burnside
2456|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|6928abbf.name: John Burnside
2457|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

277|ed056522.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

3087|0c543544.name: Crystal Boughman
3087|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

331|9c6df40b.name: Maginor Dumas
331|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

415|26f5a1f4.name: Verner Osgood
415|26f5a1f4.text: Hey ma'am, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5512|54ca4be4.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|54ca4be4.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lass, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5518|741f51fb.name: Lilliam Sparkspindle
5518|741f51fb.text: Quid pro quo! I'll teach you what I know, but first I want you to perform a small task...

5519|3d4f7092.name: Billibub Cogspinner
5519|3d4f7092.text: If you insert tab A into slot B then of course it's going to go BOOM! Here, let me show you what I have and then you can ask Lilliam about how to put it together so it doesn't blow up.

5595|9a33918c.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|9a33918c.text: You can find a mailbox right o'er by The Stonefire Tavern.  It's just north of the gates of Ironforge.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

8965|bb0bc8e7.name: Shawn
8965|bb0bc8e7.text: Hello there ma'am... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

116-accept.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-accept.text:
I find myself in quite a pinch here, $N.  The bottles are close to running dry.  The latest booze shipment is long overdue.  The orc invasion has been hell.

Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-accept.title: Dry Times

116-complete.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-complete.text:
A job well done, $N!  I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor.  But my patrons will be happy once again! 

My wife is quite a seamstress.  Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
116-complete.title: Dry Times

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

117-accept.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-accept.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-accept.title: Thunderbrew

117-complete.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-complete.text:
Hops and Barley, yeast and malt 
The taste-buds feel a virtual assault, 
No need to plead, no need to beg 
For Thunderbrew Lager comes in a keg!
117-complete.title: Thunderbrew

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

118-accept.name: Verner Osgood
118-accept.text:
I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!

Take this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire.  It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
118-accept.title: The Price of Shoes

118-complete.name: Smith Argus
118-complete.text: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!
118-complete.title: The Price of Shoes

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-accept.name: Smith Argus
119-accept.text:
Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...

Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
119-accept.title: Return to Verner

119-complete.name: Verner Osgood
119-complete.text:
Thank you, this really helps me out.

But what's this?  Argus sent a note with the crate...What??  Argus wants me to PAY him?  Bah!

Well, $N, thank you for your help.
119-complete.title: Return to Verner

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

120-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
120-accept.text:
These are trying times, $c.  The township is under constant siege.  Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat.  The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance.  Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately.  Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. 

Now make haste!
120-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

120-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
120-complete.text:
At ease, $c.

Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader.  His words carry great weight with me.  I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him.  Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support.  Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
120-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-accept.name: General Marcus Jonathan
121-accept.text:
While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. 

Dismissed, $c!
121-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-complete.text:
Thank you for your time, $c.  For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery.  Something is amiss in our Kingdom.  I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
121-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-accept.name: Verner Osgood
122-accept.text:
I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.

Black dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
122-accept.title: Underbelly Scales

124-accept.name: Verner Osgood
124-accept.text:
As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...

If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
124-accept.title: A Baying of Gnolls

125-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
125-accept.text:
I could really use a hand here, $N.  With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies.  My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out.  We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult.  Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.

Retrieve my toolbox, $N, and I'll make it worth your while.
125-accept.title: The Lost Tools

125-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
125-complete.text: Excellent recovery, $N!  I never thought I'd see these tools again.
125-complete.title: The Lost Tools

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-accept.text:
Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish.  There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!

Bring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them.  If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
127-accept.title: Selling Fish

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-accept.name: Darcy
129-accept.text:
Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.

So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
129-accept.title: A Free Lunch

129-complete.name: Guard Parker
129-complete.text: Thanks, I could really use the meal.  Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
129-complete.title: A Free Lunch

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

13-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-complete.text: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
13-complete.title: The People's Militia

130-accept.name: Guard Parker
130-accept.text:
Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
130-accept.title: Visit the Herbalist

130-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
130-complete.text:
You need a bouquet of flowers?  You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?

I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
130-complete.title: Visit the Herbalist

131-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
131-accept.text: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!
131-accept.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-complete.name: Darcy
131-complete.text:
Oh, those are lovely!  I can't wait to put them in some water!

But...these are Martie's favorite flowers.  Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he?  You didn't tell her who they were for, did you?  If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.

Oh, but it's not your fault.  Thank you, and here's your meal.
131-complete.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

14-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-accept.text: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
14-accept.title: The People's Militia

14-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-complete.text: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland.  But there is hope for Westfall yet.  As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor.  It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia.  May the Light shine upon you.
14-complete.title: The People's Militia

142-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-complete.text:
This is indeed firm proof that VanCleef is in charge.  Now all we need to know is where the Defias gang is hiding out.

We've had a stroke of luck while you were gone.  We captured a thief trying to steal Saldean's wagon.  He has promised to lead us to the hideout in exchange for his life.  I want you to defend the traitor so he can reveal the hideout.  Return to me once you have uncovered the location.
142-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

143-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
143-accept.text:
Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.

Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
143-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-complete.text: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
143-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
144-accept.text:
Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.

Take this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
144-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-complete.text:
I do say, this is not good at all.  I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire.  What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people?  Bah, I should not ponder aloud.

Here, messenger.  Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township.  I might call upon you again.
144-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
145-accept.text: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.
145-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

169-accept.name: Unknown
169-accept.text:
Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire. 

Gath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous.  He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity.  The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs.  A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.
169-accept.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

180-accept.name: Unknown
180-accept.text:
Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore

Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth.  By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead.  Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
180-accept.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

20-accept.name: Marshal Marris
20-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north.  From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.

Help rid Lakeshire of this menace.  Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.

And although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge.  If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
20-accept.title: Blackrock Menace

3741-accept.name: Shawn
3741-accept.text:
My friend Hilary lost her necklace, and we can't find it.  We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already.  The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake.  Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... my mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.

Could you find it for her, please?
3741-accept.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-complete.name: Hilary
3741-complete.text: Thank you for finding my necklace miss $c... you are very kind!  My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
3741-complete.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

89-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
89-accept.text:
During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor.  We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.

Now we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt.  If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, $N, I'll make sure you're rewarded. 

Now let's get to work!
89-accept.title: The Everstill Bridge

91-accept.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-accept.text:
An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.

Morganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.

These vile gnolls must be killed!

Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-accept.title: Solomon's Law

92-accept.name: Chef Breanna
92-accept.text:
Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.

Just bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-accept.title: Redridge Goulash

92751-progress.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92751-progress.text: Did you get a remote detonator? A normal one simply won't do!
92751-progress.title: Detonation at a Distance

92752-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92752-progress.text: Were your efforts in Stormwind fruitful?
92752-progress.title: Explosive Consultation
